title: Logical Numbering & Update Reliability Fix
summary: This update replaces timestamp-style visible numbers with short daily sequence numbers, refreshes update-release text so old notes are not reused, and widens the POS guest name and phone fields.
highlights: Short daily numbers: Bills, KOTs, QR orders, held drafts, purchase orders, and tickets now use readable sequences such as RS-260708-001 or KOT-260708-001.
Update dialog fix: Patch-only updates no longer show stale release notes from an older release.
Current release history: Update history now starts with the latest release instead of falling back to June release text.
POS cart cleanup: Guest name and phone inputs now use the full cart width and remain readable on desktop, tablet, and mobile.
